Bought by the seller in 2025 and refurbished: repaint, interior refresh (gauge housing, wiper motor, headlight switch, radio, carpet, seat covers), brakes incl. master cylinder, belts, hoses, fuel pump, plugs/wires, cap/rotor, trans cooler lines.
